property.title: The home of your Sicilian dreams

map_cta.title: Discover the wonders of Palermo and Trapani
map_cta.subtitle: Over 50 curated attractions: art and culture, dreamy beaches, nature and unmissable views.

map_page.title: Map of wonders
map_page.subtitle: All the attractions of the provinces of Palermo and Trapani, curated for the guests of Apartment Matteo. Click on the pins for directions.
map_page.locked_marker_hint: Unlock with the code to reveal name and details
map_page.unlock_description: The map is free: explore all the points of interest in the area. Enter your confirmation code to unlock the names, details and directions of each attraction, plus the personalized AI itinerary.
map_page.subtitle_free: Freely explore all the points in the area. Unlock names and details with the code you receive after booking.
map_page.itinerary_empty: Tap a point on the map and add it here to build your own itinerary.
map_page.build_hint: Click the points on the map and build your itinerary, then download it as PDF.

ai_itinerary.title: Your tailor-made itinerary, created by artificial intelligence
ai_itinerary.description: Once your booking is approved, you will receive a confirmation code. Enter it here to generate a personalized itinerary based on your dates, interests and travel style — with local advice on beaches, traditional restaurants, excursions and Sicilian traditions.
ai_itinerary.interests_placeholder: Your interests (e.g. sea, food, history, nature)

souvenir.title: The Trappeto souvenir keychain
souvenir.description: A little memory of your holiday: the faux-leather keychain with the village of Trappeto and the QR code for the website.
souvenir.gift_note: It's our gift for those who book directly on the website.
souvenir.point2: QR for the site and the AI itinerary
souvenir.point3: Free when you book here, no commissions
souvenir.cta: Book on the site and get it
souvenir.widget_text: A little memory of your holiday: the faux-leather keychain with the village of Trappeto and the QR code for our website + a digital itinerary to discover all the wonders of our area!
souvenir.itinerary_note: You'll also receive a personalized digital itinerary.

map_tutorial.dialog_subtitle: With your booking code you unlock all of this:

code.title: Enter your code
code.desc: You receive the code by email once your booking is confirmed. Enter it once to unlock the whole map.

details.title: Discover names and details
details.desc: Every attraction shows its name, opening hours, prices, suggested duration, guest discounts and links to tickets and directions.

itinerary.title: Build your itinerary
itinerary.desc: Add the places you like with a tap and put together your tailor-made trip, right from the map.

pdf.title: Download the PDF
pdf.desc: Export the full itinerary as a PDF, ready to take with you even offline.
